premises.text: Mobile email remains cluttered with frustrating formats, metadata, and repeating signatures
premises.evidence_span: you will need to go through all these frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures again and again

premises.text: Intelligent content parsing reformats inbox email into a messaging-style conversation view
premises.evidence_span: MailTime's intelligent content parsing engine can reformat all your emails into this conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging

premises.text: At-mentions assign tasks and a to-do tab manages email-derived tasks
premises.evidence_span: you can also mention someone with an at symbol to assign a task

premises.text: Participants can be added or removed like managing a group chat
premises.evidence_span: You can remove someone from the mail or add someone. As easy as what to do, like managing a group chat

premises.text: Client warns when outbound emails are too long to encourage short readable messages
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime just told me that it's too long, didn't read

premises.text: Email content syncs directly between mail server and phone without cloud content access; cloud only pushes change notifications
premises.evidence_span: we send and receive every single email just directly between your mail server and Mailtime on your phone. So we don't touch any content

premises.text: Freemium pricing: first email account free, additional accounts $0.99
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime will be free to connect with first email account. We will charge you only $0.99 if you want to connect more email account with Mailtime

value.text: Smartphone email that feels like text messaging without desktop clutter
value.evidence_span: It's a way how we design email for your smartphone
